name: session-protocol
description: Session memory for Claude Code and Codex: hot.md + session log at the end of every session, recorded in the background when you forget.

auto_close.title: Auto-close forgotten sessions
auto_close.description: When a working session ends without the protocol, run it in the background (a headless Claude run, costs tokens). Off: only remind.

model.title: Model for auto-close
model.description: Model for the background run, e.g. sonnet or haiku. Empty: your default model.

min_prompts.title: Minimum prompts
min_prompts.description: Sessions with fewer prompts count as trivial and are not closed.

extra_tools.title: Extra allowed tools
extra_tools.description: Comma-separated tool rules the background run may use besides the read-only defaults, e.g. read-only MCP tools of your issue tracker.

add_dirs.title: Extra directories
add_dirs.description: Colon-separated directories the background run may read, e.g. other repos the sessions touch.

notify_command.title: Notify command
notify_command.description: Command that gets <title> <body> as two arguments (Slack, Telegram, ntfy). Empty: desktop notification.
